## 1. Objective, Non-Negotiable Guardrails & Keep-vs-Discard Audit

Deliver a self-contained, auditable RFI/RFP pursuit response package under `agent-output/{pursuit_slug}/` for
`{customer_name}` (`{rfp_id}`), reconciling every mandatory technical, statutory, and commercial requirement against
first-party Microsoft Learn documentation and `prices.azure.com` retail meter evidence.

### 1.1 Non-Negotiable Engineering & Commercial Guardrails

1. **Immutable Source Archive Rule:** Treat all customer-supplied `.xlsx`, `.docx`, `.pdf`, and `.msg`/`.eml` files as
   strictly read-only. Hash every input via `extract_pursuit_sources.py` (`SHA-256`) and reject symlinks, path
   traversal, macro payloads, or XML DTD/entity expansion.
2. **Compliance Over Cost Precedence:** Statutory data residency, sector regulator rules, encryption, and explicit
   resiliency SLAs (`{rpo_target}` / `{rto_target}`) strictly override lowest-cost SKU or region selection. Document
   any compliant cost delta in `{pursuit_slug}.model-changelog.md`.
3. **Single-Region Default Unless Multi-Region Is Required:** Default to a single zone-redundant Azure region
   (`{primary_region}`, such as `swedencentral` with Availability Zones 1–3 and `ZRS` storage) unless solicitation
   clauses, sovereign survivability rules, or cross-region DR targets explicitly require a secondary region (such as
   `germanywestcentral`).
4. **Zero Deprecated or Retiring SKUs:** Audit every proposed Azure service and SKU against official retirement
   notices and regional GA availability before locking sizing. Replace legacy services (`DEP-*`) upfront rather than
   pricing end-of-life components.
5. **Strict Commercial Persona & Rate-Lock Boundary:** Enforce `{commercial_persona}`
   (`microsoft_1p_partner_advisory`, `partner_prime_bidder`, or `isv_solution_provider`). Never fabricate non-1P
   partner labor, carrier, or ISV license rates (emit `"QUOTE REQUIRED"` sentinels), and never claim Microsoft
   price-locks unreserved PAYG consumption meters.
6. **Two-Part Purview & Derived-Data Release Gate:** Treat both raw source files and derived deliverables containing
   customer inventory metrics as sensitivity-governed. External archive generation requires documented Purview
   label-owner approval plus `--acknowledge-purview-clearance` and `--exclude-restricted-originals`.
7. **APEX Validator & Filename Hygiene:** Keep the exact `PROJECT-README` H2 structure in `README.md`, avoid reserved
   delivery-step filenames (`01-requirements.md`, `02-architecture-assessment.md`, `03-des-cost-estimate.md`,
   `04-implementation-plan.md`, `04-governance-constraints.md`, `07-*.md`), and never invoke artifact linters directly
   on `agent-output/**`.

| Audit ID | Prior / Requested Item | Disposition (`Keep` \| `Replace` \| `Discard`) | Technical, Regulatory, or Commercial Rationale | Reconciled Target / Owner |

| `KVD-02` | `{source_item_2}` | `Replace` | Legacy/retiring SKU (`{dep_id}`) or insufficient IOPS/resiliency for `{rto_target}` target | `{target_component_2}` |

## 4. Workstreams & Verification Gates ({WS1}..{WS6})

### Workstream Execution Sequence

1. **`{WS1}` — Read-Only Source Intake & Clause Traceability:** Run `extract_pursuit_sources.py` against
   `{readonly_source_dir}` to generate `pricing/source-manifest.json`, extract structured `.xlsx`/`.docx` content into
   `source/`, and log data anomalies into `Q1`–`{Qn}`.
2. **`{WS2}` — Architecture Synthesis, Keep-vs-Discard & SKU Audit:** Map every clause to Azure controls with
   epistemic tags (`[source-verified]`, `[customer-reported]`, `[vendor confirmation required]`, `[drill unproven]`),
   eliminate retired SKUs, and lock `{DEC-01}`–`{DEC-N}`.
3. **`{WS3}` — Retail Pricing Capture & Live-Formula `.xlsx` BoQ:** Invoke `cost-estimate-subagent` for Azure retail
   pricing evidence, build `commercials/{pursuit_slug}.boq.xlsx` with live formulas (never hardcoded summary totals),
   populate typed `<v>` cached values via `xlsx_ast_cache.py`, and reconcile `BRG-01`–`{BRG-N}`.
4. **`{WS4}` — Synchronized Architecture & Commercial Diagrams:** Generate high-resolution `.py` -> `.svg`/`.png`
   architecture, lifecycle, and scenario cost visuals under `assets/` bound to reconciled SKU and pricing totals.
5. **`{WS5}` — Narrative Pack, Commercial Playbook & Executive Handoff:** Author `01-technical-response.md`,
   `00-bid-playbook.md`, `00-partner-handoff-email.md`, `{pursuit_slug}.evidence-and-provenance.md`,
   `{pursuit_slug}.model-changelog.md`, optional `.pptx` deck, and `README.md`.
6. **`{WS6}` — Deterministic Gates, Peer Review & Release Packaging:** Execute `Gates 1–4` below, resolve any numeric
   or prose drift across files, and run `package_pursuit.py` only when outbound Purview clearance is satisfied.
